# just-makeit

> just-makeit is a command-line tool that scaffolds and builds Python C
> extensions. From a single `just-makeit.toml` manifest it generates C source,
> a CMake build, CPython bindings, type stubs, and tests — so you write only the
> algorithm, not the binding boilerplate. It compiles through **just-buildit**, a
> PEP 517 build backend that drives CMake and packages the wheel.

just-makeit and just-buildit are companion, pure-Python tools for shipping
native (C) Python extensions without hand-writing CPython glue:

- **just-makeit** — the generator/CLI. `jm new`, `jm object`, `jm function`,
  `jm method`, `jm app`, `jm build`/`jm test`. The generated C-extension type is
  the public API; there is no Python wrapper layer.
- **just-buildit** — the **PEP 517 build backend** (`build-backend =
  "just_buildit"`). It compiles CMake-based C/C++ Python extensions and builds
  the wheel. It is usable on its own for any CMake Python extension project, not
  just code generated by just-makeit.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/): full guide
- [Feature map](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/feature-index/): every feature mapped to the example that demonstrates it
- [Feature tour](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/feature-tour/): build a complete extension in one copy-paste session
- [Workflow](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/workflow/): the scaffold → implement → build → test loop
- [Decision tree](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/decision-tree/): which command for which task
- [Quick reference](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/quick-reference/): commands and flags at a glance
- [Configuration](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/configuration/): the `just-makeit.toml` schema
- [Object-of-objects](https://just-buildit.github.io/just-makeit/object-of-objects/): capsule, composer, and handle generators for composing objects of objects

## Build backend (just-buildit)

- [just-buildit on GitHub](https://github.com/just-buildit/just-buildit): the PEP 517 / CMake build backend
- [just-buildit on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/just-buildit/)

## Source and packages

- [just-makeit on GitHub](https://github.com/just-buildit/just-makeit)
- [just-makeit on PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/just-makeit/)
